narr: The remnants of tropical storm Kay were centered off the California coast but helped generate enough shear to produce severe thunderstorms that moved north across southeast Arizona during the afternoon and early evening. Large hail, heavy rain and flash flooding occurred in southwest Tucson.
ev: Heavy rain of 2-3 in 90 minutes caused flash flooding in southwest Tucson. Roads closed include Old Ajo Highway, Long Cast DR. and Iberia Ave.
lsr: PIMA COUNTY SHERIFFS DEPARTMENT REPORTED THE INTERSECTION OF WILMOT ROAD AND SAHUARITA ROAD CLOSED DUE TO FLOODING.
